decision: Reject this Q8 invocation-reuse implementation for production: allocation reduction is established, but longer synthetic generation measurements show a repeatable runtime cost. Restore the prior refined Q4 runtime exactly. This does not reject every possible Q8 reuse design.

before.description: Previous local refined Q4 candidate, not unmodified main

rejected_candidate.implementation: Ordinary Q8 arithmetic moved unchanged into linearQ8Range using the existing shared x/y/w/n descriptor. Inline calls use a stack descriptor; parallel calls initialize q8Fn lazily, join all workers, then clear references. The wide fallback remains before callback setup. No arithmetic, partition, threshold or numerical-tolerance change.
rejected_candidate.reproduction: The patch contains the complete runtime delta from ancestor_commit plus the five added Go test/harness files, including the candidate allocation/lifetime tests. Apply only in a separate clean checkout of ancestor_commit; the current dirty worktree already contains retained Q4 work and a different post-rejection Q8 test file. git apply --reverse --check succeeded against the exact candidate before restoration. Build with ./scripts/go.sh test -c ./cmd/monolith, and CGO_ENABLED=0 ./scripts/go.sh build -trimpath ./cmd/monolith. Source hashes identify bytes; independently rebuilt binary hashes can vary with checkout path/build environment. The patch does not include local models or raw model stdout.

allocation.warm_kernel: TestQ8InvocationSteadyAllocation first failed on the baseline at workers1/rows1 with 1 object per call. Candidate passed with zero objects at workers1/2/4 and rows1/2/3/4/5/17. Cold parallel callback creation is not included in the warm zero-allocation claim.
allocation.interpretation: Allocation reduction alone is not a speedup. After rejection, the production Q8 path retains its existing per-call allocation; the current baseline test reports it without asserting that it must remain. The exact zero-allocation candidate tests are preserved in the patch.

correctness.ordinary: Candidate passed exact float32-bit comparison against baselineLinearQ8Into on 882 worker/row/input/output combinations, plus output guards and cleared shared references. Shape sets: workers1/4, rows0/1/2/3/4/5/7/8/17, inputs1/3/63/64/65/129/513, outputs1/2/31/32/33/65/259.
correctness.lifetime: Candidate callback was intercepted to block all four participants: the call did not return or clear state until release; workers joined, exact output matched and shared references cleared. Multiple independent executors and alternating Q4/FP32/Q8 calls passed, including race validation.
correctness.wide: Extreme activations produced bit-identical wide-fallback results, including infinity, without initializing q8Fn. An initial test helper incorrectly rejected equal infinities because it also evaluated an arithmetic error check; this test was changed to compare Float32bits directly, without changing production arithmetic.

generation.broad_protocol: Three alternating before/after blocks; fresh processes, 18 fixed-order leaves each, 300ms benchmark duration. Own full race/compatibility validation overlapped this broad pass. Preserve these samples, but do not use their timings for adoption. Allocation evidence is consistent with focused kernel tests and the later pass.
generation.followup_protocol: After all owned validation/model jobs completed: three alternating before/after blocks, fresh processes, 1s leaves, count1, prefix33/outputs128, all three formats and workers1/4 (six leaves per process). No other owned heavy job ran during this pass. Host background activity remains uncontrolled.
generation.same_binary_protocol: Three additional alternating label blocks with the preserved baseline binary on both sides, 1s leaves, Q8 workers1/4, prefix33/outputs128. Labels do not denote different code in this control.
generation.interpretation: The candidate is approximately 5-6% slower on the longer Q8 synthetic condition; FP32/Q4 and same-binary medians do not show a comparable cost. This supports rejecting this candidate on this workload, not a universal performance conclusion. Ratios compare independently calibrated estimates, not matched requests; only three blocks were collected. No confidence interval, code-generation cause, spilling claim, model timing or control-subtracted speed estimate is asserted.

real_model_outputs.settings: generate -hf-model MODEL -weight-format FORMAT -weight-mib 14000 -prompt 'Write a detailed history of the city of Tokyo.' -max-tokens 128 -temperature 0 -threads 4; FORMAT=q8 or q4
real_model_outputs.comparison: Fresh candidate complete stdout was compared by cmp against preserved refined-baseline stdout; baseline CLI and saved-output hashes were checked against the prior receipt. The baseline model was not rerun in this round. Both formats matched. No real-model timing inference or cross-format identity is claimed.
real_model_outputs.availability: Models, stdout and executables remain local ignored artifacts. Benchmark raw files and source patch are retained with this receipt.

verification_candidate.compatibility: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.22.12 GOARCH=amd64 ./scripts/go.sh test ./cmd/monolith -run 'TestProjection|TestSharedProjection|TestWideSumScanPredicates|TestQ4|TestQ8|TestWorkerLinearSteadyAllocation' -count=1 passed under Rosetta; not native Linux testing
verification_candidate.python: 52 unittest tests passed; pytest also passed 52 tests and 469 subtests
verification_candidate.scope: go test ./... still fails on the pre-existing ignored runs/dbg_special_test.go, which refers to unexported monolith symbols from a separate package. That file was neither removed nor modified. No remote CI, commit, push or PR in this round.

restoration.meaning: Production source restored byte-for-byte to the pre-Q8 refined Q4 candidate. Executor remains120 bytes. Prior Q4/FP32 sharing, lazy callbacks and safety scan remain; the rejected Q8 callback and range helper are absent. All earlier receipts and raw data are unchanged.
restoration.tests: Keep ordinary Q8 shape/guard, independent-owner and wide-path regression coverage in cmd/monolith/q8_invocation_test.go. Candidate-only callback/lifetime and zero-allocation assertions remain in the archived patch, not active production tests.
restoration.verification: After restoration: regular cmd/tools tests, vet, targeted Q8/Q4/shared-state/projection race tests, the same targeted tests under Go1.22.12/amd64, gofmt and git diff --check passed. Full race passed on the rejected candidate; after restoration only targeted race was rerun.

next_hypothesis: Investigate the generated Q8 hot-loop/descriptor extraction before attempting another reuse design. Code shape, bounds checks and register allocation are hypotheses only; no cause has been established. Do not recover the observed slowdown by changing numerical tolerances or reviving the rejected column-pairing experiment.
